description: This file defines a ChatGrain class implementing event-sourced chat functionality using Orleans. It manages chat state as an XML document, handles initialization, and processes chat events like post, delete, and edit.

classes.name: ChatGrain
classes.description: An Orleans event-sourced grain implementing chat functionality with XML-based state management and support for chat events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation to initialize the chat state if not already initialized.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Applies chat events to the XML document state.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Returns the current chat XML document.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds a new chat message event.
